hooks.command: count=0; for d in "${HOME}/.codex/skills"/*/; do name="$(basename "${d%/}")"; case "${name}" in .*) continue;; esac; [ -L "${d%/}" ] || count=$((count+1)); done; for d in "${HOME}/.claude/skills"/*/; do name="$(basename "${d%/}")"; case "${name}" in .*) continue;; esac; [ -L "${d%/}" ] || count=$((count+1)); done; [ "${count}" -gt 0 ] && echo "unmanaged skills: ${count} — run 'roborepo skill adopt <name>' to version-control" || true

_descriptions.RoboRepo: unmanaged skills check: Checks the Codex and Claude skill folders for unmanaged skill directories and suggests adopting them into RoboRepo.
_descriptions.RoboRepo: protected branch push: Blocks pushes that land on main, master, or the remote's default branch.
_descriptions.RoboRepo: command permissions: Applies RoboRepo’s command permission rules before a shell tool runs.
_descriptions.RoboRepo: concise command output: Limits noisy build, lint, and typecheck output and blocks matching watch, verbose, and debug commands.
